pages.text: The Magma Generator consumes lava as a fluid. Right-click it with a lava bucket to pour in the fuel, or connect a fluid pipe. The internal tank holds eight buckets. Right-click without a lava bucket to open the controls.

pages.title: Lava and Output
pages.text: One bucket burns for 100 ticks at 20 FE/t, producing 2,000 FE. Generator upgrades shorten the burn without changing that yield.$(br2)Use a $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:mining/ender_thermic_pump)Thermic Pump$(/l) and fluid transport to automate lava supply.
